//: Hygiene tsconfig flags - WEB. These three flags are the compiler half of the AI-dead-code net (the eslint rules are the other half). bootstrap.sh MERGES these into your existing tsconfig.json compilerOptions (it does not replace your tsconfig). Shown here as a standalone fragment for reference and for a manual merge.

compilerOptions.//allowUnreachableCode: false = the compiler ERRORS on code after a return/throw/break. Catches dead code an AI left behind.
compilerOptions.//noUnusedLocals: true = an unused local variable is a compile error.
compilerOptions.//noUnusedParameters: true = an unused function parameter is a compile error (prefix with _ to intentionally ignore).
